schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Private apps, not published libraries: move package.json ranges along with the lockfile
PrimeVue, its Nuxt module and the Aura theme package release in lockstep; the built-in monorepo preset misses their new repo
One weekly PR for stable npm minor/patch updates. 0.x bumps (vite-plus, @swc/cli, ...) count as breaking and stay separate
Workflow-only changes rebuild no image, so batch them separately from app updates
Base-image digest refreshes (OS security patches) together, so one merge rebuilds all affected images at once
Move the Node.js runtime major everywhere at once: .node-version (local + CI) and both Dockerfiles
@types/node has to match the runtime major: approve it on the Dependency Dashboard together with the Node.js major
A Postgres major needs a pg_upgrade of the prod data volume: only on explicit request via the Dependency Dashboard
Our own images are built by CI and deployed as :latest; never pin or update them
